hooks.rewakeMessage: Conductor delivered team work addressed to you. It may arrive in the middle of a task: fold it into what you are doing. If no one started this turn, no human is necessarily present, so do not ask a question and wait. The delivery follows. Act on it, then carry on -- the next watcher arms itself automatically.
